pages.meta_description: Meet Shital Thosar, the artist and creator behind DotAndArt. Discover her journey of handmade dot mandalas and Lippan mirror art.

content_json.title: The Heart & Hands Behind DotAndArt
content_json.subtitle: Handcrafted dot mandalas and Lippan mirror creations born out of love, patterns, and meditative calm.

content_json.paragraph_1: Hi, I’m Shital Thosar, the artist and creator behind DotAndArt.
content_json.paragraph_2: What started as a love for colours, patterns and the simple joy of creating with my hands slowly grew into something much more meaningful—my own art journey.
content_json.paragraph_3: I found myself drawn to Dot Mandala Art, where tiny dots come together to create intricate patterns, balance and harmony. For me, mandala is not just about creating something beautiful. It is a process of slowing down, being present and finding a little calm in the middle of everyday life.
content_json.paragraph_4: With time, my art has evolved into a blend of traditional mandala patterns, contemporary colours and Indian artistic influences. I enjoy experimenting with colours, textures and different forms while keeping the handmade character of every piece alive.
content_json.paragraph_5: Every DotAndArt creation is painted by hand, one dot and one detail at a time. Whether it is a personalised photo mandala, a festive piece, a wall artwork or a custom creation, I put a little piece of my creativity and love into each one.
content_json.paragraph_6: Today, DotAndArt is not just about selling handmade art. It is about creating meaningful pieces that become part of someone's home, celebrations and memories.
content_json.closing_signature:
Thank you for being a part of my creative journey.
With love,
Shital
Artist & Founder, DotAndArt
